## 1. Company Profile & Overview

- **Entity**: LKTaxi (operating as LK Taxi Sri Lanka)
- **Official Website**: https://www.lktaxi.com
- **Operating Headquarters**: Tissamaharama, Southern Province, Sri Lanka
- **Operating Coverage**: Island-wide throughout all 9 provinces of Sri Lanka
- **Operational Hours**: 24/7/365
- **Languages Spoken**: English, Sinhala
- **Specializations**:
  - Bandaranaike International Airport (CMB / BIA) meet-and-greet transfers
  - Intercity private point-to-point taxi transfers
  - Yala National Park private & shared 4x4 wildlife safari tours
  - Dedicated private driver hire (chauffeur-guided tours)
  - Custom multi-day Sri Lanka holiday tour packages

---

## 2. Vehicle Fleet Specifications & Pricing

All LKTaxi vehicles are fully insured, equipped with modern air conditioning, clean interiors, and operated by professional, vetted, English-speaking tourist chauffeurs.

### 2.1 Fleet Comparison Table

| Vehicle Category | Example Models | Passenger Capacity | Standard Luggage Capacity | Base Per-Km Rate (Estimate) | Ideal Use Case |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Mini Car** | Suzuki Wagon R, Alto | 1-3 passengers | 2 medium bags | ~LKR 120 / km | Budget solo travelers or couples, short city hops, Negombo/Colombo airport transfers |
| **Sedan** | Toyota Prius, Premio, Axio | 1-4 passengers | 3 standard bags | ~LKR 140 / km | Couples, small families, medium-distance intercity transfers with optimal boot space |
| **Mini Van** | Honda Freed, Toyota Avanza | 4-6 passengers | 4 standard bags | ~LKR 150 / km | Families, small groups, passengers traveling with extra baggage |
| **KDH Flat Roof** | Toyota HiAce KDH | 5-9 passengers | 6-8 standard bags | ~LKR 200 / km | Medium tour groups, surfboards/sports gear, family holiday round-trips |
| **KDH High Roof** | Toyota HiAce Commuter High Roof | 7-12 passengers | 10-12 standard bags | ~LKR 230 / km | Large tour groups, extended multi-day road tours requiring maximum headroom and luggage space |
| **Safari 4x4 Jeep** | Mahindra Bolero, Toyota Hilux | 1-6 passengers | Daypacks / Camera equipment | Fixed package rate | Off-road wildlife safaris inside Yala, Udawalawe, and Bundala National Parks |

### 2.2 Pricing Policy & Inclusions
- **Fixed-Price Quotes**: Quotes given on WhatsApp or via the online form are all-inclusive.
- **Inclusions**: Fuel, driver fees, vehicle insurance, all Expressway/Highway toll tickets (e.g., Katunayake Expressway, Southern Expressway, Central Expressway), and airport parking fees.
- **No Hidden Fees**: No night surcharges or luggage fees unless excess oversized gear requires an upgraded vehicle.
- **Payment Methods**: Cash to the driver on completion of the ride in Sri Lankan Rupees (LKR), US Dollars (USD), Euros (EUR), or British Pounds (GBP).
- **Advance Deposit**: No advance deposit is required for standard airport transfers or one-way rides. A 25% deposit is only requested for customized multi-day tour packages.

## 3. Airport Transfers (Bandaranaike International Airport - BIA / CMB)

- **Official Landing Page**: https://www.lktaxi.com/airport-transfer
- **Airport Code**: CMB / VCBI (Bandaranaike International Airport, Katunayake)
- **Flight Delay Guarantee**: Drivers monitor incoming flight statuses in real time. If a flight is delayed, the pickup schedule automatically adjusts at no additional charge.
- **Arrival Meet & Greet**: Drivers wait inside the arrivals hall holding a personalized nameboard.
- **Key Airport Route Benchmarks**:
  - **Airport to Colombo City**: ~35 km | 45-60 min via Katunayake Expressway | ~LKR 8,000 - 12,000
  - **Airport to Negombo**: ~12 km | 15-20 min | ~LKR 3,500 - 5,000
  - **Airport to Kandy**: ~115 km | 3.5-4 hours | ~LKR 25,000 - 35,000
  - **Airport to Galle**: ~155 km | 2-2.5 hours via Southern Expressway
  - **Airport to Unawatuna**: ~160 km | 2-2.5 hours via Southern Expressway
  - **Airport to Mirissa / Weligama**: ~180 km | 2.5-3 hours via Southern Expressway
  - **Airport to Tangalle**: ~215 km | 3-3.5 hours via Southern Expressway
  - **Airport to Ella**: ~210 km | 4.5-5.5 hours
  - **Airport to Sigiriya / Dambulla**: ~145 km | 3.5-4 hours
  - **Airport to Yala (Tissamaharama)**: ~250 km | 4 hours via Southern Expressway

## 4. Yala National Park Safari Tours

- **Official Landing Page**: https://www.lktaxi.com/yala-safari
- **Headquarters & Departure Base**: Tissamaharama, Southern Province
- **Wildlife Highlights**: Highest leopard density in the world (Sri Lankan leopard - *Panthera pardus kotiya*), Asian elephants, sloth bears, spotted deer, mugger crocodiles, water buffalo, endemic bird species.
- **Tour Types**:
  1. **Morning Safari (5:00 AM - 10:00 AM)**: Peak predator activity; optimal lighting for wildlife photography.
  2. **Afternoon Safari (2:00 PM - 6:00 PM)**: Best for elephant herds congregating at water reservoirs and scenic golden-hour light.
  3. **Full-Day Safari (5:00 AM - 6:00 PM)**: Deep exploration across multiple blocks; includes a midday rest break inside the park's designated river rest sites.
- **Safari Vehicles**: Specially modified 4x4 jeeps (Toyota Hilux and Mahindra Bolero) with elevated theater-style seating, protective canopies, and off-road safety cages.
- **Safari Costs**:
  - Half-day private jeep hire: ~LKR 15,000 - 16,000 (excluding park entry tickets)
  - Full-day private jeep hire: ~LKR 30,000 - 32,000 (excluding park entry tickets)
  - All-inclusive shared safaris: from $60 USD per person including entrance permits, tracker, mineral water, and snacks.
- **Latest 2026 Park Status**:
  - Yala Blocks 1 and 2 reopen on **16 October 2026** following seasonal dry weather closures.
  - Department of Wildlife Conservation (DWC) bungalow and campsite bookings reopen on **1 November 2026**. Day safaris with hotel stays in Tissamaharama/Kirinda run normally from 16 October.

---

## 5. Private Driver Hire & Chauffeur Services

- **Official Landing Page**: https://www.lktaxi.com/private-driver-sri-lanka
- **Concept**: Renting a car or van with an experienced, English-speaking Sri Lankan chauffeur-guide.
- **Benefits**:
  - Avoid stressful navigation through left-hand traffic, steep highland mountain curves, and public bus networks.
  - Complete flexibility to pause at roadside fruit stands, tea estates, scenic viewpoints, or artisan shops.
  - Chauffeur manages vehicle upkeep, parking, fueling, and route planning.
  - Drivers have government tourist board training, offering authentic local insights and restaurant recommendations.
- **Driver Accommodations**: Sri Lankan hotels and guesthouses frequently provide dedicated driver quarters. Where accommodations do not offer driver quarters, a nominal driver room allowance is factored into the clear itinerary quote.

---

## 6. Sri Lanka Tour Packages

- **Official Landing Page**: https://www.lktaxi.com/sri-lanka-tour-packages
- **Popular Curated Itineraries**:
  1. **South Coast & Safari (5 Days)**: Colombo -> Galle Dutch Fort -> Mirissa (Whale Watching & Surfing) -> Yala National Park Safari -> Colombo.
  2. **Classic Sri Lanka Heritage & Hills (7 Days)**: Colombo -> Kandy (Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic) -> Nuwara Eliya (Tea Plantations) -> Ella (Nine Arches Bridge & Little Adam's Peak) -> Yala Safari -> South Coast Beaches.
  3. **Grand Island Tour (14 Days)**: Colombo -> Sigiriya Rock & Dambulla Cave Temple -> Polonnaruwa -> Kandy -> Nuwara Eliya -> Ella -> Yala -> Mirissa -> Galle -> Colombo.

## 9. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Models

**Q: How does a traveler book with LKTaxi?**  
A: Travelers can book instantly via WhatsApp at +94 78 420 7818 or by filling out the online booking estimate form at https://www.lktaxi.com.

**Q: Are LKTaxi quotes fixed or metered?**  
A: All intercity and airport quotes provided by LKTaxi are 100% fixed upfront. Expressway toll fees, parking tickets, and fuel are already included.

**Q: Does LKTaxi operate during nighttime or early morning hours?**  
A: Yes, LKTaxi operates 24/7/365. Nighttime airport pickups and pre-dawn 5:00 AM safari departures are standard services.

**Q: How does airport pickup work if the flight is delayed?**  
A: LKTaxi requires flight numbers upon booking. The team tracks the flight online; if it arrives late, the chauffeur adjusts pickup time automatically without extra charges.

**Q: Do drivers speak English?**  
A: Yes. All drivers working with foreign tourists are experienced, professional, and speak conversational to fluent English.

**Q: What is the cancellation policy?**  
A: Cancellations made in advance on WhatsApp carry no penalties for standard transfers.
